disclaimer: Generic transaction roadmaps for a non-resident individual buyer, current mid-2026. Sequence, documents and costs vary by deal - confirm every step with your own independent lawyer. Not legal advice.

stages.title: Offer & reservation
stages.detail: Agree price and a reservation deposit to take the property off market. Deposit terms should be in writing and refundable on failed due diligence.

stages.title: Engage independent lawyer
stages.detail: Engage a lawyer who is NOT recommended by the selling agent. Verify them in the Sofia Bar register.

stages.title: Title & legal due diligence
stages.detail: Confirm clean title, no mortgages/liens, building has Act 16, seller has no outstanding property-tax or utility debt. For off-plan, verify the developer's permits and stage (Act 14/15/16).

stages.title: Preliminary contract (predvaritelen dogovor)
stages.detail: Binding contract fixing price and completion date; usually 10% paid into escrow / via lawyer. Never pay to a personal account.

stages.title: Open bank account & transfer funds
stages.detail: A Bulgarian account eases the transaction and later rent collection. Bring source-of-funds documentation for AML.

stages.title: Notary deed & completion
stages.detail: Sign the notarial act, pay the balance, local transfer tax (municipal, ~2-3%) and notary fee. Title transfers on signing.

stages.title: Registration & tax setup
stages.detail: Register the deed; register for local property tax; set up utilities. Declare the property to the municipality.

stages.title: Obtain codice fiscale
documents: Application at Agenzia delle Entrate or consulate
stages.detail: The Italian tax code is mandatory for any purchase, bank account or utility. Get it first.

stages.title: Engage lawyer + geometra survey
stages.detail: An independent geometra (surveyor) checks cadastral conformity and unpermitted works (abusivismo) - endemic in Sicilian historic stock. Non-negotiable.

stages.title: Proposta d'acquisto (offer)
stages.detail: Written, binding-once-accepted purchase proposal with a small deposit. Have your lawyer review before signing.

stages.title: Compromesso (preliminary contract)
stages.detail: Binding preliminary contract; deposit (caparra) typically 10-20%. Register it to protect your position. Verify APE and habitability.

stages.title: Rogito (notarial deed)
stages.detail: The notaio (neutral, not your advocate) completes the sale. Pay balance, registration tax (9% of cadastral value for a second home), notary and cadastral fees.

stages.title: Registration, IMU & rental setup
stages.detail: Notaio registers the deed. Register for IMU (annual property tax). For short lets, obtain the national CIN code and register with the Comune. Elect cedolare secca for rental tax.

stages.title: Obtain AFM (tax number) & bank account
stages.detail: A Greek AFM is required to buy, and funds must be traceable through the banking system for the price to be recognised.

stages.title: Engage independent lawyer
stages.detail: Engage your own lawyer (verify in the Athens Bar). They run the title search and represent you, separate from the notary.

stages.title: Title search & due diligence
stages.detail: Verify clean title at the land registry, building permit and any legalisation of unpermitted areas, and forest/archaeology encumbrances (can apply even in urban Attica).

stages.title: Preliminary agreement & deposit
stages.detail: Optional but common; fixes terms and a ~10% deposit held safely. Confirm the seller's ENFIA (property tax) is fully paid - unpaid ENFIA blocks transfer.

stages.title: Notarial deed & transfer tax
stages.detail: Pay transfer tax (3.09%) before signing; the notary executes the deed and both parties (and lawyers) attend.

stages.title: Land registry & rental/short-let setup
stages.detail: Register the deed at the Cadastre. For short lets obtain an AMA number - BUT new AMA registrations are frozen in central Athens Districts 1-3 until 31 Dec 2026. Register rental income with AADE.
